card.name: Amounts just before currency names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a money amount, such as a number, 'thousand', 'million', 'billions of', or the start of 'florins', right before the currency name (dollars, crowns, thalers, Euros). Mostly in historical or news text about salaries, prizes and costs.

modes.label: Number or scale word before currency
modes.description: A figure or scale word like thousand, million or billions of sits right before the currency name.
modes.example: They will share half the prize of 1.4<< million>> dollars, the other half going to three

modes.label: Start of an old currency name
modes.description: The first part of a split currency name such as florins, in historical text about pay.
modes.example: a monthly stipend of twelve<< flor>>ins.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict a currency word like dollar, dollars or pound next.
card.plain: It lights up when a sum of money is being stated and the currency name is about to come.
